description: This Java class 'PermissionController' is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing user permissions in an admin web interface. It handles HTTP requests to display permission pages and fetch permission data via AJAX, integrating with permission services and other related components.

classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing user permissions within the administrative interface.
